title: Smart Data Models - DataProvider
description: A technical agent (ETL, connector, ingestion service) that injects DigitalAssetMetric observations into the data space. Decoupled from Organization so that the same metric for the same channel on the same day can be supplied by multiple providers (e.g. an internal pipeline and a third-party agency) and remain distinguishable in the historic.

id.description: Unique identifier of the entity. Recommended pattern: urn:ngsi-ld:DataProvider:<short-name>.

type.description: Property. NGSI Entity type. It has to be DataProvider.

name.description: Property. Human-readable name of the provider (e.g. 'LIN3S Ariadne ETL', 'Acme Internal Pipeline').

description.description: Property. Free-text description of what this provider does and how it processes data.

providerKind.description: Property. Optional classification of the provider's relationship with the brand owner. 'Internal' = pipeline operated by the same Organization that owns the Brand. 'External' = an independent third party. 'Agency' = a marketing agency operating on behalf of the brand. 'Self' = the SaaS itself (e.g. Google sending raw data).

version.description: Property. Version or release identifier of the provider's pipeline/connector. Useful for reproducibility when two versions of the same provider co-exist.

url.description: Property. URL of the provider's service or documentation.

refOrganization.description: Relationship. URN of the Organization that LEGALLY OWNS the data emitted by this provider. In a sovereign data space this is typically the same Organization that owns the Brand (canonical Internal case).

refOperator.description: Relationship. URN of the Organization that TECHNICALLY OPERATES the pipeline (executes the ETL, owns the credentials, runs the connector). Optional: omit when operator equals owner (refOrganization). Use it to make explicit a delegation, e.g. an integrator running the pipeline on behalf of the data owner.
